name: Post-Training Survey

scoring.report_note: Report room-level means only, always including the lowest item. Never report individual sheets or rankings. A high mean on the reverse item (pts-06) is a design alarm, not a passing grade.

description: A one-page post-training feedback survey: 6 Likert items (1-5) plus 2 open questions. Designed to go one step past the satisfaction sheet — relevance, transfer intent, pace, facilitation quality, clarity, and one reverse-scored blocker item.

instructions.when: Last 5 minutes of the session, in the room. Same-evening link only if the agenda runs to the minute; next-day distribution collapses response rate below 25%.
instructions.how: Anonymous. One answer per item, every item answered. Open questions: one honest sentence each.

items.text: The session matched the problems I actually face at work.
I can name one thing from today I will use within two weeks.
The pace and difficulty fit the room.
The facilitator made space for questions and disagreement.
I knew what each exercise was for while it was running.
Nothing from today will change how I work.

open_items.prompt: What is the one thing you will do differently on Monday?
What got in the way of your learning today?

report.title: Post-Training Survey — room-level summary
sections: Response rate and item means, lowest item named
Count of concrete Monday commitments (open item 1)
One quoted obstacle with permission (open item 2)
